seoPage.title: Do EVs Lose Resale Value Quickly? Myth vs Reality | EVSavari
seoPage.metaDescription: Do EVs Lose Resale Value Quickly? Myth vs Reality — practical ownership guidance for Indian buyers.
seoPage.intro: The myth: EV resale is always terrible. The reality: the used EV market is still maturing — some models hold value well; others fall faster when new tech or charging worry dominates.

editorialSections.title: The myth
paragraphs: Early adopters faced thin used markets. Today, more data exists — but EV resale still varies more than mature petrol segments.

editorialSections.title: Practical reality
bullets: Battery health documentation helps used pricing.
Popular city models with strong service may retain better.
Rapid new launches can pressure older variants.

editorialSections.title: Plan your hold period
paragraphs: If you swap cars every 3–4 years, research resale for your exact variant now — not after purchase.

misconceptions.reality: Demand exists for well-documented city commuters.
EV secondary markets are younger — expect volatility.

faq.question: Will I lose more than petrol?
faq.answer: Depends on model, km, battery perception, and local demand — research your variant.

faq.question: Improve resale?
faq.answer: Service history, battery health reports, and realistic km.

faq.question: Lease vs buy?
faq.answer: Leasing shifts resale risk — compare total cost.

faq.question: Buy used instead?
faq.answer: See used EV buying guide — verify pack and warranty.

faq.question: Compare?
faq.answer: Balance running savings vs resale uncertainty for your hold period.
